{{Top|leg}}
The pyramidal '''Science Service tower''' was a branch of the [[Corulag Academy|Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] that housed the [[Science Service]]. Around [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Frexton]], [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the Service, kidnapped a six-[[Standard month/Legends|month]]-old [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child named [[Teela Panjarra]] and took her here so he could study [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She was [[Mission to Corulag|retrieved]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
